svg.text: 03 Foot drawer bay frames — build two
BED v8 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Join Head between Side L/R; fit rear brace and Top. Repeat for the other side.
2. Leave the wheel path open to the room floor. Do not add the old full bay bottom.
3. Fit the plywood L strips between sides. Leave the 25 mm finger gap above the front.
4. Dry-fit the drawer before joining this module to the rest of the platform.
